messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we keep seeing the gradual KV residency spiral on shard pools during long-running batch workloads. Need to lock down owners + short remediation plan.

katie: Ack. can we list the immediate actions and owners? Prefer 2-week timeline for each item so ops can verify.

sahil: I'll take profiling + allocation flame graphs. Plan: run the new heap-sampler on the heavy clusters, capture a 2h window during peak, and upload to /eng-runtime/artifacts. ETA 48h.

jing: I'll own guardrails and circuit breaker limits. Proposal: add a soft-residency cap + background eviction when shard residency > 70% for > 10m. Rule config below: 
```yaml
kv.eviction.soft_limit_pct: 70
kv.eviction.soft_limit_window: 600s
kv.eviction.background_rate_per_sec: 100
```
I'll run canary on staging next Tue.

alex: @sahil @jing sounds good. sahil add a small prompt with the capture command for CI.

sahil: command for profiler: `./heap-sampler --out s3://redwood-eng/kv-profiles/$CLUSTER-$TS.pb --duration 7200s --sample-interval 250ms`
I will paste upload link when done.

katie: Owner for GC tuning and slab fragmentation analysis? We need a checklist: 1) collect profiles, 2) run compaction tool, 3) simulate long lived prefixes, 4) validate on staging.

alex: i'll take GC tuning and sim harness. plan: iterate quantile-based GC threshold, measure tail-latency and resident set. 5 business days per iteration.

jing: Also suggest adding a recurring telemetry alert for 'residency_change_rate > X' to catch the slow drift. can we set X = 0.5% per minute? cc @ci-bot to open alert.

ci-bot: Created alert: ENG-RUNTIME-RESIDENCY-DRIFT (threshold: 0.5%/min sustained 15m). Ticket #4582.

katie: Good. We should also capture a short runbook blurb so oncall can triage: steps to force-evict, how to roll back, and quick mitigations. Can someone draft?

sahil: Drafting now. Will include commands for: `kvctl cluster evict --shard SHARD --rate 200` and `kvctl drain --shard SHARD --grace 60s` plus logs to check: `kv.residency`, `heap.alloc.rate`, `slab.fragmentation`.

alex: timeline summary:
- sahil: profiling capture (48h) -> 3250080000
- jing: staging canary (next Tue) -> 3250150000
- alex: first GC tuning iteration (5d) -> 3250420000
- katie: runbook + alert (24h) -> 3250020000
Make sure owners update the thread with links.

jing: One more thing — recurring pattern note for the postmortem doc: these spirals often follow sustained KV write bursts from batch jobs. Can we add a mitigation to stagger batch windows? ops to own scheduling policy.

katie: Agree. i'll ping platform-scheduling to add jitter to big batch windows.

alex: Thanks all. Next sync Friday unless we get new infra alerts. Please drop links to artifacts in this thread. :thumbsup:

sahil: Uploaded profile: s3://redwood-eng/kv-profiles/cluster-a-3250009000.pb -- added brief notes in the artifact object.

jing: Staging canary config: https://staging.console/redwood/kv/evict-canary-325 (ran smoke, looks stable so far).

katie: Runbook draft: https://docs.redwood.internal/eng-runtime/residency-eviction-runbook.md (open for comments).

alex: closing action: owners will post results or blockers in this thread. I'll do a quick weekly digest in #eng-runtime on Friday.

sahil: noted. will paste profiling PR when ready.
